questions.stem: Why is it important for scientists to monitor changes in ecosystems over time?

options.text: To discover new species that can be used as pets
To detect changes caused by pollution, climate change, or habitat loss and take appropriate action
To count every single organism in the ecosystem
Monitoring has no practical value for conservation

questions.explanation: Monitoring ecosystems over time allows scientists to detect environmental changes such as declining species populations, increasing pollution levels, or the effects of climate change. This data is essential for making informed decisions about conservation and environmental management.
